paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Zohar, Tazria, 76a: he spoke in the name of R' Yeisa Saba.[^1]

notes.text: Yeisa’s title is abbreviated and retained as R', restoring the historical neutral title. Saba is retained for both heading and body as the Elder designation, without identifying the persons. 76a follows the full-stop convention; the Zohar edition locator remains independently unverified. Earlier printed wording refers only to the supplied digital label; no printed page was inspected.
